name: Laser Toolbox
author: tmuka
description: Laser basics for a grblHAL router with a laser module beside the spindle: check the laser setup, calibrate the spindle-to-laser offset (grblHAL $770/$771) and the crosshair (positioning laser) offset, zero on the stock with the crosshair, and run material, focus and cut-through tests to find power, feed and focus.
